For the target video, at 0.00 seconds, <Picture 1> and <Picture 2> from [Shot 1] are fully referenced, with <Picture 3> as the campus setting. 保持夏日放学时段、梧桐林荫道与暖金色斜阳、怀旧干净的老式校园氛围，两人穿搭严格贴合参考图，全程写实电影感。

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 0.0-4.0s 侧面中景，16:9，放学时段的林荫道，阳光从树叶间洒下斑驳光斑。A young man in a black V-neck knit cardigan over a white shirt and black trousers walks out from the campus building side, a schoolbag over one shoulder. A young woman with twin braids, a dark grey checked coat over a white collared blouse and red knit sweater, carrying books, approaches from the opposite direction under the plane trees. They spot each other at the same moment, slow down slightly and smile at each other. The camera holds a gentle lateral tracking shot at walking speed, a few leaves drifting across the foreground.

[Shot 2] 4.0-8.0s 中近景跟拍，镜头与两人同速侧移。The girl hands the boy one of her textbooks with a light, slightly shy smile; he takes it and tucks it into his bag, glancing at her. They turn and walk side by side along the tree-lined avenue, shoulders relaxed, the boy occasionally looking sideways at her while she looks ahead with a faint smile. Sunlight alternates rapidly across them through the leaves; the hem of her skirt and the ends of her braids move gently with the breeze. Camera stays at chest height, a subtle dolly forward adding depth.

[Shot 3] 8.0-12.0s 侧后低机位跟拍，逐渐拉远。The two walk together toward the far end of the avenue where the light softens into warm golden haze, silhouettes lengthening on the road under the setting sun. The girl glances back at him one last time with a gentle smile, he looks at her in return, and they continue side by side into the tree-shadowed distance. A few fallen leaves are lifted by the breeze across the lens; the frame ends on their receding backs, the extending avenue and scattered light.

overall_soundscape: 放学时段的校园环境底噪：远处隐约的上课铃声余音与零星人声、树叶沙沙、轻快的脚步声、布料与书本轻微摩擦声。

non_diegetic_music: 木吉他与钢琴合奏的温暖旋律，节奏轻快明朗、略带青春心动感，音量低，不盖过环境声，结尾自然淡出。

【禁止项】可读文字/Logo/UI/水印/字幕；禁止动漫、卡通、二次元、3D渲染风格，必须是写实真人电影质感；禁止服装与发型变化、额外人物、现代元素（手机、耳机、机动车）、画面抖动闪烁与无来源光效。
【强制声明】无台词；人物身份、服装、发型与林荫道结构全程一致；全片无生硬跳切。

使用流程：
① 在「统一输入」节点内上传参考图（支持多图，点选上传）→ 填提示词或切换「提示词模式」用AI生成 → 设时长

· 「AI提示词生成」区：填中文需求 + 参考图 → 本地大模型自动生成专业提示词 → 「提示词模式切换」拨到 2
· 时长自动按 H3 的17帧块对齐（默认12秒）
· 加速节点（Veda/BlockSparse/SageAttention，需RTX 4090）默认停用，右键启用即可提速

只需修改：统一输入的提示词/参考图/时长、4K倍率；其余已调好，勿改动。
